news.headline: Urban Company Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 182 crore; revenue jumps 41% YoY
news.summary: Urban Company reported a net loss of Rs 182 crore in Q2FY27 as investments in its quick services business, InstaHelp, weighed on profitability. Revenue rose 41% year-on-year to Rs 537 crore, while orders grew 103%. The company also approved a fresh capital raise of up to Rs 2,500 crore, subject to shareholder approval.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
news.summary: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

news.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%
news.summary: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Private lender ICICI Bank reported a net profit of Rs 14,843 crore in the second quarter of financial year 2027, marking 20.1% year-on-year increase from Rs 12,359 crore posted in the same period last year.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 19,510 crore; NII grows 10%
news.summary: HDFC Bank Q2 Results: India’s largest private lender HDFC Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 19,509 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a 4.6% year-on-year jump from Rs 18,641 crore posted in the same period last year.

news.headline: Axis Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 38% YoY to Rs 7,003 crore, NII rises 12%
news.summary: Axis Bank Q2 Results: Private lender Axis Bank on Saturday reported a net profit of Rs 7,003 crore for the second quarter of FY27, marking a jump of 38% from Rs 5,089 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

news.headline: Jio’s $3.2 billion IPO tests Ambani appeal with young Indians
news.summary: Reliance Industries Ltd. is gearing up to introduce Jio Platforms Ltd., anticipated to be the largest IPO in India. Slated for October 21, 2023, the IPO aims to attract around $3.2 billion. With shifting investor perspectives, particularly among the younger demographic who favor immediate profits over long-term investments, Jio's valuation is being closely examined alongside rivals like Bharti Airtel.

news.headline: Cult.fit receives Sebi approval for proposed IPO
news.summary: Cult.fit has received Sebi observations for its proposed IPO, comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 950 crore and an offer for sale. Revenue rose 36.26% in FY26, while adjusted EBITDA margin improved significantly as fitness operations expanded nationwide.

news.headline: ICICI Bank Q2 Results Preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 21% YoY; margins, deposit growth in focus
news.summary: ICICI Bank is expected to report 15.8-18% year-on-year growth in net interest income and 15-21% growth in profit after tax in Q2FY27, according to brokerage estimates. Investors will track net interest margins, loan and deposit growth, operating profitability and asset quality, with margin pressure and provisioning trends remaining key monitorables.

news.headline: IT's time to celebrate when chips are down; Nifty IT soars 11.7% to log biggest weekly rally since 2008
news.summary: The Indian IT sector experienced an impressive surge, achieving its highest weekly increase in 18 years, driven by unexpectedly strong quarterly results from companies like HCLTech. The Nifty IT index jumped 11.7%, amidst falling semiconductor stock prices in Asia. Furthermore, the rupee showed notable strength, closing below the 95-mark for the first time in 38 days, reflecting the effective measures implemented by the Reserve Bank of India.

news.headline: CoreWeave stock wipeout exposes divide between AI fear and greed
news.summary: CoreWeave Inc. is navigating turbulent stock trends due to climbing bond yields and investor trepidation over its debt, raising fears of default. Although a temporary boost followed optimistic comments from Nvidia's CEO, the overall sentiment leans towards caution. Analysts believe that while funding needs are pressing, robust AI demand could mitigate rate worries. Furthermore, CoreWeave's alliance with Nvidia may be a vital source of financial support in these unpredictable conditions.

news.headline: Mukesh Ambani taps massive Reliance workforce to boost Jio’s record IPO
news.summary: Mukesh Ambani is mobilising Reliance Industries’ workforce to boost interest in Jio Platforms’ record IPO. The conglomerate has encouraged employees to consider investing, released October salaries early and set aside shares for eligible employees and Reliance shareholders.

news.headline: Persistent Systems shares slide 5% despite Q2 revenue growth. Buy, sell or hold?
news.summary: Persistent Systems shares fell 5% despite 7.8% sequential constant-currency revenue growth in Q2FY27, as margin contraction and a sharp decline in profit weighed on sentiment. Brokerages remained divided on the stock amid valuation concerns and acquisition-related costs.

news.headline: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit tanks 39% YoY to Rs 2,205 crore; NII dips 49% YoY
news.summary: IDBI Bank reported a 39% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 2,205 crore in Q2 FY27, impacted by a one-off gain in the previous year. Excluding this, profit rose 14%. Asset quality improved, deposits grew 17%, advances increased 18%, and net interest margins strengthened sequentially to 4.11%.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 15% in a month
news.summary: Five BSE 500 stocks—Shyam Metalics, PVR Inox, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Indian Hotels and Laurus Labs—hit fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex gained 413 points. All five stocks posted monthly gains of around 8% to 15%, signalling positive momentum.

news.headline: Yes Bank Q2 preview: Will strong profit, NII growth offer relief for investors amid AT-1 bond saga?
news.summary: Yes Bank is expected to post a 48% YoY jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 969 crore, driven by robust loan growth and higher NII. However, investor focus remains on the Supreme Court ruling invalidating its Rs 8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, which has pressured the stock.
